title: Injectivity of the agreement profile
statement: For every natural number $n$, the map sending a linear threshold function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to its low-degree agreement profile for degrees at most $1$ is injective. In other words, two such functions with the same number of agreements with each parity function indexed by a subset of size at most $1$ must be equal.
